items.title: build.jenesis:build.jenesis.launcher 0.6.1 发布, A bootstrap for executable jars produced by Jenesis. The launcher is shaded into the jar root and runs the bundled application out of the one jars/ store the jar keeps its dependencies in, reading class and resource bytes on demand from the still-open outer jar - nothing is held in memory or extracted to disk. What each path holds is named by META-INF/jenesis/application.properties rather than shown by where a jar sits: what classpath names becomes the unnamed module of a single loader, and what modulepath names is resolved into a fresh java.lang.ModuleLayer mapped to that same loader, preserving full modularity. The same machinery serves a module that keeps a dependency private: it declares a layer, requires this module, and asks for it by name, and the dependency is resolved into a layer of its own - read from the same jar, never relocated and never unpacked.

        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.
